title: Backend System Showcase
subtitle: Six repositories, one backend ecosystem: feature flags, audit logs, payments, an AI assistant and a proactive monitoring agent working together.
intro: A payment is created in Payment Tracking, the state change is logged automatically in the Audit Log System, a feature flag controls the active flow, the AI Admin Assistant summarizes the day in plain language, and the eve Audit Agent watches all of it in the background, without being asked.

featureFlags.name: Feature Flags Dashboard
featureFlags.role: Controls application behavior per user context, with a plain-language "why is this flag ON" explanation.

auditLog.name: Audit Log System
auditLog.role: Traces every user action with a timeline UI, replay and suspicious activity detection.

paymentTracking.name: Payment Tracking System
paymentTracking.role: Payment lifecycle state machine with refunds and receipt linking.

aiAdmin.name: AI Admin Assistant
aiAdmin.role: Natural language queries over the audit logs and payments, backed by real business data.

branchOrigin.name: Branch Origin Finder
branchOrigin.role: CLI/web tool that infers a Git branch's likely parent from merge-base, reflog and confidence scoring.

eveAgent.name: eve Audit Agent
eveAgent.role: Proactive agent that watches Supabase events in real time and reports anomalies with a human approval gate.

status.heading: Live status
status.description: Read directly from the shared Supabase instance, the same tables the other four projects write to.
status.empty: No data yet. Run the seed scripts in feature-flags-dashboard, audit-log-system and payment-tracking-system first.
status.unavailable: Live status unavailable. Check the Supabase credentials in .env.local.

architecture.heading: Architecture
architecture.description: No service bindings, no message queue: each module reads and writes the same Supabase instance. Feature Flags, Audit Log, Payment Tracking and AI Admin Assistant share the audit_logs, payments and users tables. This hub only reads them.
